name: Ahi Tuna Tartare
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table / Disney Wonder · Triton's
whyItWorks: Finely diced sushi-grade raw ahi tuna and creamy mango/avocado require zero mechanical grinding and deliver clean, lean omega-3 protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to hold any chili oil, radish slices, or sesame seeds, and verify the soy-ginger dressing if you are on strict citrus-exclusion medications. Pair with white rice or soft bread instead of hard taro/wonton crisps if flaring.
watchOuts: Sharp fried wonton or taro chips
